components.name: Solar Cells (Monocrystalline Silicon)
components.reasoning: These are the core photovoltaic conversion elements producing electricity, universally present as the primary functional component for monocrystalline modules.

components.name: Tempered Glass Cover
components.reasoning: This front protective layer provides weather resistance and high light transmission, a standard feature in nearly all commercially available solar modules.

components.name: Aluminum Frame
components.reasoning: The structural support and mounting interface is a distinct assembly commonly procured separately to provide mechanical rigidity and facilitate installation.

components.name: Encapsulation Material (EVA)
components.reasoning: Encapsulant sheets protect and secure cells between the glass and backsheet, procured as a specific polymer subassembly, common in virtually all modules.

components.name: Backsheet
components.reasoning: The rear protective layer insulates electrically and acts as a moisture barrier, typically procured as a discrete component unless replaced by glass-glass designs.

components.name: Junction Box
components.reasoning: This electrical junction point with bypass diodes is a critical separate component for safe module operation and external wiring connections.

Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.name: Aluminum
Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.reasoning: Used for back contacts and frame; universal in solar cell design due to its conductivity and lightweight properties.

Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.reasoning: N-type dopant creating PN junctions critical for cell function; standard but some gallium or arsenic dopants may be alternatives.

Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.name: Boron
Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.reasoning: P-type dopant for silicon cells; standard doping element though gallium can sometimes be used as alternative.

Solar Cell.name: Aluminum
Solar Cell.reasoning: Back contact and structural frame material, widely used for its conductivity and strength.

Chassis Assembly.reasoning: Primary material for frame and structural support due to light weight, corrosion resistance, and mechanical strength.
